# MyLearnPlus
#
# Everything public is crawlable. The four paths below are not disallowed
# because they are secret — they are disallowed because they are worthless to a
# search engine and expensive to crawl: a cart and a checkout are per-visitor
# and change on every request, the account area is behind a sign-in, and search
# results are an unbounded space of pages generated by whoever typed into the
# box, which a site otherwise ends up competing with itself for.
#
# /verify/ is left crawlable-but-noindexed by the page itself rather than
# blocked here, so a certificate's QR code resolves for anybody scanning it.

User-agent: *
Disallow: /*/cart
Disallow: /*/checkout
Disallow: /*/account/
Disallow: /*/search
Disallow: /admin/

Sitemap: https://learnplus.livezencloud.com/sitemap.xml
